description: Answer a question from the web when you have no URL yet: runs a web or news search and returns the top 1 to 5 result pages already read as clean Markdown, with title, URL and snippet. Replaces one search call plus several page reads. If links and a short summary are enough, web-search is cheaper. Charged only if at least one page was read. Params: query (required), source ('web' default or 'news'), count (1 to 5, default 3), max_chars per page (500 to 20000, default 4000). Price: $0.012 USDC per call, paid inside this MCP call via x402 (USDC on Base or Solana). x402 MCP clients such as @x402/mcp pay automatically. Free sample: call with the example input {"query":"x402 payment protocol","count":2,"max_chars":3000}.
name: search_read
title: Search and Read
